events.verdict: Gobert (MIN) rests his forearm against Doncic's (DAL) body and the contact during the driving shot attempt is marginal.
Thompson (DAL) is in a legal guarding position moving alongside of Edwards' (MIN) path to the basket and Edwards loses control of the ball on his own.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Edwards (MIN) steps out of bounds and makes contact with the ball.
Thompson (DAL) establishes himself in Alexander-Walker's (MIN) path, but leans forward and delivers contact.
Gobert (MIN) briefly has a hand placed around Lively II's (DAL) waist before Lively II deflects the ball away as the two players engage during the rebound.
McDaniels (MIN) reaches across Doncic's (DAL) left shoulder/arm and initiates contact that affects his play at the basket.
Washington (DAL) steps on the baseline out of bounds before releasing his pass.
McDaniels (MIN) initiates illegal contact with Doncic's (DAL) arm and face prior to the ball being dislodged by Alexander-Walker (MIN).
Lively II (DAL) reaches across Edwards' (MIN) body and initiates contact that affects his driving shot attempt.
There is no clear and conclusive video evidence to determine if Thompson (DAL) steps out of bounds.
Randle (MIN) initiates contact with Lively II's (DAL) arm, which affects his play at the basket.
Thompson (DAL) legally contests Edwards' (MIN) jump shot attempt.
Irving (DAL) and Alexander-Walker (MIN) mutually engage and disengage during the rebound.
Edwards (MIN) commits a take foul on Irving (DAL).
Marshall (DAL) makes clean contact with the ball and deflects it away from Edwards (MIN) during the drive.
Alexander-Walker (MIN) commits a take foul on Marshall (DAL). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
Marshall (DAL) legally contests Edwards' (MIN) jump shot attempt.
Edwards' (MIN) jump shot attempt lands out of bounds.
